_comment: LIVE catalog for the Free TV app. Editing this file changes the app's channels with no release. 'Space' is our own scheduled channel (kind=scheduled): a published running order the app resolves to whatever should be on air now — built from NASA's media library, a US federal government work and public domain by statute, fetched from nasa.gov so provenance is guaranteed. NASA's insignia is NOT public domain: keep it out of channel artwork, and nothing may imply NASA endorses the app. Other entries are Creative Commons (Blender open movies) or official developer test streams. Run check-streams.sh before committing.
